references: Arte original do projeto e solicitação de mobiliário doméstico brasileiro de 1996
orientation: Frente/tampo RPG 2D; bancos e sofá vistos por trás e voltados ao norte. Orientação funcional usada na planta, sem giro plano.
prompts: Create twelve NEW isolated furniture sprites for Edelzio's childhood house in Varginha, Minas Gerais, Brazil, in 1996. A modest warm lived-in 1990s family home, nostalgic rather than fancy. Match the reference game's own strict 2D topview RPG camera: visible front faces and top surfaces, deliberate squared pixel clusters, dark readable outline. Warm medium brown wood, faded teal/blue upholstery, ochre, cream enamel and subtle vintage colors. Exactly 12 complete objects, 4 columns x 3 rows, reading left-to-right top-to-bottom, landscape 1536x1024, true transparent RGBA background with generous transparent gutters. No labels, grid, scenery, shadows, glow, blur, smoothing or modern devices. STYLE reference only; do not reuse existing furniture designs. Order: 0 child's wooden single bed with simple blue patchwork quilt and cream pillow, a small box of colored building blocks and a toy car near the foot of the bed; 1 compact wood drawing desk with colored pencils and blank paper, no computer or laptop; 2 cream 1990s refrigerator with a few small colorful magnets; 3 cream enamel four-burner gas stove with oven, classic Brazilian family appliance; 4 small brown wooden and cream formica family dining table with two modest stools beside it and a fruit bowl; 5 chunky CRT television with knobs and rabbit-ear antenna on a small 1990s wooden TV stand, no flat screen; 6 faded teal two-seat sofa facing NORTH toward the TV, viewer sees the exterior BACK of the sofa from SOUTH, include a modest folded blanket over one arm, do NOT show the seats facing the viewer; 7 low simple wooden coffee table with folded newspaper and cream enamel cup; 8 family kitchen sink on a simple cream and brown cabinet with soap and dishcloth; 9 plain compact cream ceramic bathroom washbasin on a little wood stand; 10 classic white ceramic toilet with cistern; 11 modest small rectangular glass shower enclosure with blue shower curtain, viewed with its front and top recognizable. Cohesive physical proportions and same logical pixel density; logical sprites roughly 32-72 pixels wide with large square pixels enlarged by an integer. Every headboard, antenna, stool, handle and shower frame fully inside its cell, at least 24 transparent pixels padding. All twelve objects separate, no humans. New pixel art faithful to game's general graphics and modest Brazilian 1996 home.
